# Speech rollout: Bodhan AI first, Sarvam kept as the fallback

The stages for putting Bodhan AI in front of Sarvam. Each stage has a check that must hold before the next one starts. The gates are recorded in `docs/evidence/speech_gates.md` (front matter `bodhan_tts`, `bodhan_stt`); the API logs a warning at startup while Bodhan is first for a function whose gate has not passed.

| Stage | What runs | Check before the next stage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. Development only | Bodhan first on a developer's machine and in tests (mock); never in a deployment teachers use. `SPEECH_TTS_PROVIDERS=sarvam,bodhan` and `SPEECH_STT_PROVIDERS=sarvam,bodhan` in every shared deployment | `python scripts/check_bodhan.py` works with the keys; `docs/vendors/bodhan/TERMS-CHECK.md` is filled in (retention, training use, hosting region, DPA, attribution); prices confirmed on the console and marked `verified: true` in `content/speech_prices.yaml` |
| 2. Shadow mode on speech to text | Sarvam answers; `SPEECH_SHADOW_PROVIDER=bodhan` sends the same audio to Bodhan in the background and logs only a similarity score and the latency (rate-limited, counted in the session cap, off by default) | A week of shadow logs: the median similarity and Bodhan's latency are acceptable to Gopi; no text in any log (`tests/speech/test_outage_privacy.py`) |
| 3. Bodhan first for lesson generation, with coach review | `SPEECH_TTS_PROVIDERS=bodhan,sarvam` for lessons (batch: rate limit paced); every lesson listened to on the review screen, sentences regenerated where flagged | The listening test passes: `bodhan_tts: pass` recorded with `--record` (naturalness within 0.3 of Sarvam, under 5% "numbers wrong"; thresholds to be confirmed); Bodhan's rate limit raised for the account |
| 4. Bodhan first for the Practice Class, after both gates pass | `SPEECH_STT_PROVIDERS=bodhan,sarvam` and Bodhan first for children's voices in live turns | `bodhan_stt: pass` recorded (CER no more than 5 points worse than Sarvam, key terms at least 90%); the live latency run (`scripts/practice_voice_latency.py --live --yes`) shows Bodhan's first audio no slower than Sarvam's; a live turn does not wait for the rate allowance (seen on 1 Nov: Bodhan's first audio median 14.7 s against Sarvam's 7.9 s; default allowance about 8 requests a minute) |
| 5. Sarvam kept as the fallback, permanently | Both providers configured; the chain falls back on errors, timeouts, rate limits and an open breaker | The outage test passes on every change (`tests/speech/test_outage_privacy.py::test_with_both_providers_down_lessons_and_template_lines_play_and_the_text_shows`); `SARVAM_API_KEY` is never removed from a deployment |

Today (1 Nov 2026): stage 1. Both gates `pending`. Nothing on this branch (`speech-bodhan`) is merged into the evaluated version.
